patch.value: Canonicalize complete standup reads on pm CLI 2026.8.21

Replace the deprecated list-all subprocess with one strict, full, doubly-unbounded canonical list --all request; delegate shared corpus proof to the public SDK; reject the remaining verified receipt gaps; exact-pin the current host; and prove installed npm and Bun behavior with real tracker data.

Create one canonical reader for every standup consumer; assert the exact canonical argv; require SDK certification plus narrow supplemental checks; validate fields used by the renderer; exact-pin development pm CLI/SDK 2026.8.21 while proving the declared behavior floor; add fresh packed npm/npx and Bun/bunx acceptance with real items and no deprecated stderr; update docs, changelog, CI and release gates; retain independent exact-coverage and privacy blockers
Main is clean at 2d0077a; 59 complete tracker items were read; 145 tests and current release gate pass; the deprecated runtime call and current receipt gaps are reproduced.
Run the current standup reader and inspect its argv: it invokes list-all without strict-read, full projection, or either unbounded output control.
A standup is rendered only from a structurally valid, SDK-certified, complete tracker corpus using canonical CLI syntax.
The current reader invokes deprecated list-all, checks only items/truncated/total, uses pm CLI 2026.8.15, and has no packed npm/Bun installed-host acceptance.
A partial or unverifiable tracker read can under-report active work in an automated standup, while alias warnings pollute agent stderr.
